# Attachment

A file attached to a message, with its name, type and size.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Multi-brand</span> Multi-brand draws on core, content and media families, not conversation. It admits only families in its roles. Its only messages go to support through a textarea. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./textarea">Textarea</a></span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-attachment--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:light" title="Attachment examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-attachment--docs">Open Attachment in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-attachment--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** A conversation that shares files people may open or download.
- **Not when:** Uploading files in a form (a file input), or images meant to be seen inline.

Instead:

- [Message](./message.md): The message the file belongs to.

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The link names the file and its type and size, not just Download. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add attachment
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Attachment reads 17 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Attachment's tokens to change Attachment alone.
